F.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, announced a Trunk or Treat event to be held on Friday, October
13, 2023, from 4 – 6 PM.

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced that a Red Ribbon Rally Walk
will be held on October 24, 2023, at 4:30 PM; Teen Center is hosting a Haunted Maze on October 27 –
28 from 6 – 9 PM; and the annual Halloween Spooktacular event will be held on October 31, 2023.
